item.title: Bail hearing booked for woman charged in multi-unit fire in Blenheim
item.description: Jocelyne Charuk, 42, of Blenheim, made a brief court appearance in a Chatham court on Monday by video.

item.title: Workforce Week aims to help prepare Chatham-Kent residents for job opportunities
item.description: Chatham-Kent is growing which is expected to create new job opportunities for residents.

item.title: Local roundup: Matteis, Branton win OUA gold; Bluebirds even series
item.description: Chatham’s Quinn Matteis and Port Lambton’s Shona Branton were big winners at the OUA swimming championships.

item.title: Man who supplied gun testifies at Walpole Island murder trial

item.title: Stroke survivors, caregivers sought to help design recovery ‘roadmap’
item.description: If you have experienced a stroke or transient ischemic attack (TIA), or cared for someone who has, the Chatham-Kent Health Alliance wants to hear from you.

item.title: Wheatley man charged in drug trafficking investigation: OPP
item.description: A man faces charges in connection to a drug trafficking investigation in Wheatley, Ontario Provincial Police said.

item.title: Chatham-Kent's proposed waste to energy project takes next step
item.description: As preliminary approval was needed before any final decision, a proposed waste-to-energy project took the next step Monday night.

item.title: Nearly 100,000 votes in salt-spreaders naming contest
item.description: The names are in for a pair of school board salt-spreaders in Sarnia-Lambton and Chatham-Kent.
